text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what an exceptionally pleasant 
morning it is today! The humidity is just 
right, and the temperature is perfect!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
More than anything... I woke up a whole 
ten minutes before my alarm clock!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Based on my level of fatigue, I calculated 
that it would be impossible to wake up 
before 6:00. Yet I—woke up a whole ten 
minutes early!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My stamina has increased even beyond my 
expectations! Ah, what a delightful 
miscalculation!!

With a radiant smile, Biwa Hayahide headed 
toward the school building.
